HAI.title: Haier 365-day exchange
terms: •  The 1-to-1 exchange coverage is valid for 365 days from the purchase date, as stated on the product invoice (not from the registration date).
•  This promotion is valid from 1 May 2026 to 31 December 2026.
•  The exchange program applies strictly to malfunctions caused by manufacturing defects. It does not cover wear and tear, accidental damage, or misuse.
•  Only one replacement is allowed within the 365-day coverage period.
•  The product must be purchased and used within Malaysia.
•  Products used for commercial purposes are not eligible for this program.
•  All other terms and conditions are subject to the standard warranty card provisions.
